answer: The jetty leases berths on the nebula, a finite register of slots. Its rule: a berth opens only when the holder's flare escrow covers every berth they already hold, so each new berth doubles the stake, one flare, two, four. A sparrow, paid by the nebula, signs each settlement and attests the holder's running count, so a fresh chain cannot reset it. The jetty forfeits the whole escrow if any berthed identity is judged fake, so a thousand clones cost 2^999 flares of locked capital. An honest newcomer on a virgin nebula locks one.
